extraMeanings.en: the edible seeds of certain plants such as lentils, beans, and peas
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Lentils, beans, and chickpeas are all types of pulse rich in protein.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mercimek, fasulye ve nohut hepsi protein açısından zengin baklagil türleridir.

extraMeanings.en: a cold or hot drink made from fruit juices, often with alcohol
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She served a fruit punch at the party.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Partide meyveli bir içki (punç) ikram etti.

extraMeanings.en: a tool for making holes
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He used a punch to make holes in the leather belt.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Deri kemerde delik açmak için bir delgeç kullandı.

extraMeanings.en: a firm hold or grip on something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He couldn't get any purchase on the slippery rock.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kaygan kayada tutunacak bir yer bulamadı.

extraMeanings.en: a request for information from a database or search system
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The database returned no results for that query.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Veritabanı o sorgu için hiçbir sonuç döndürmedi.

extraMeanings.en: an animal or person that is being hunted or chased
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The hunters finally cornered their quarry.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Avcılar sonunda avlarını köşeye sıkıştırdı.

extraMeanings.en: relating to a sexual or gender identity that is not heterosexual or cisgender
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She is a proud member of the queer community.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kuir topluluğunun gururlu bir üyesidir.

extraMeanings.en: a task or mission in a video game
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You must complete this quest to unlock the next level.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir sonraki seviyeyi açmak için bu görevi tamamlamalısın.

extraMeanings.en: to repeat words that someone else has said or written
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She often quotes Shakespeare in her essays.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Makalelerinde sık sık Shakespeare'den alıntı yapar.

extraMeanings.en: to cause someone great physical or mental suffering
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was racked with guilt after the accident.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kazadan sonra suçluluk duygusuyla kıvrandı.

extraMeanings.en: far-reaching or thorough; affecting the fundamental nature of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company made radical changes to its business model.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket iş modelinde köklü değişiklikler yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to make a sudden attack on or search of a place
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Police raided the building early in the morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis sabahın erken saatlerinde binaya baskın yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to recover or improve after a difficult period
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The stock market rallied after the announcement.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Borsa açıklamanın ardından toparlandı.

extraMeanings.en: a car-racing competition on public roads
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He won the international car rally last year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geçen yıl uluslararası araba rallisini kazandı.

extraMeanings.en: to hit or push something with great force
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The truck rammed into the wall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kamyon duvara toslayarak çarptı.

extraMeanings.en: a road for entering or leaving a highway
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Take the exit ramp toward the city center.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezine giden çıkış yolunu kullan.

extraMeanings.en: a chemical process in which substances change
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The reaction between the two chemicals produced heat.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İki kimyasal arasındaki tepkime ısı üretti.

extraMeanings.en: to care for and raise a child or animal until it is grown
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They reared four children on a small farm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Küçük bir çiftlikte dört çocuk büyüttüler.

extraMeanings.en: the back part of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The kitchen is at the rear of the house.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mutfak evin arka tarafındadır.

extraMeanings.en: a letter or person that provides information about someone's character or abilities
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her former boss agreed to act as a reference.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eski patronu referans olmayı kabul etti.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel less tired or hot
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A cold shower will refresh you after the long walk.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra soğuk bir duş seni tazeleyecek.

extraMeanings.en: to update a web page or screen with the latest information
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Refresh the page to see the new comments.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni yorumları görmek için sayfayı yenile.

extraMeanings.en: to consider or think of someone or something in a particular way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Many people regard him as a genius.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Birçok insan onu bir dahi olarak görür.

extraMeanings.en: to improve a system, law, or institution by making changes
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government promised to reform the tax system.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet vergi sistemini reform etmeyi (düzeltmeyi) vaat etti.

extraMeanings.en: to feel sorry about something you did or failed to do
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I regret not telling her the truth.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ona gerçeği söylemediğim için pişmanım.

extraMeanings.en: to move unsteadily or feel shocked and confused
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He reeled backwards after the blow.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Darbeden sonra geriye doğru sendeledi.

extraMeanings.en: to say something as a comment
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She remarked that the weather was unusually warm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Havanın alışılmadık derecede sıcak olduğunu söyledi.

extraMeanings.en: to pass on information or a message to someone else
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please relay this message to your team.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bu mesajı ekibine ilet.

extraMeanings.en: a short summary of what has been said or done
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Here is a quick recap of today's main points.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İşte bugünün ana noktalarının kısa bir özeti.

extraMeanings.en: protection or shelter from danger or trouble
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They sought refuge from the storm in a nearby cave.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan yakındaki bir mağarada sığınma aradılar.
